licenses.text:
De Heilige Schrift 1917, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/nld/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/nld/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in Dutch, 1917
> Public Domain
> Language: Nederlands (Dutch)
> 2023-01-23

What was found:
Text: the Statenvertaling (1637), titled 1917 by eBible, in spelling from after 1947.

Why it stays out: missing fact: eBible's text matches word for word the Jongbloed-edition text on statenvertaling.net (the 1886 NBG revision, in spelling later updated by people the site does not name; not the 1977 Tukker edition); the edition and editors of that spelling update after 1947 are unknown, and so is whether the GBS, which took over Jongbloed's rights in 2021, claims rights in it.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=nld), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/nld/copyright.htm), https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Statenvertaling.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)
